_comment: NATIVE-RESOLUTION RESCALE (t-141, boss send-back 2026-08-17): the prior anchor_logical_height=48 crushed the whole set to a 48px-tall system -- the character head rectified to ~8-11px vs ~100-145px in the source, so no facial feature, screen glyph, plank seam or crack could survive the ~7-10px cell pitch. That single knob was the shared root cause under every prior per-sprite send-back (smeared face, blob monitor, slab desk, flat tile). Raised uniformly to 320 across ALL FOUR manifests, so the shared scale-anchor character is 320px on every sheet (cross-sheet scale consistency preserved -- the mission's 'scale consistent across the set' bar, now at a 6.67x-larger anchor the boss's resolution ruling supersedes the literal 48). Pitch is now ~1.1-1.5 (near source-native): the head lands ~100px, matching the cited source region, and detail survives on its own. Every region's grid phase is pinned [0,0]: at near-native pitch a sub-pixel phase offset is immaterial, and pinning removes best_phase's O(36 x grid) cost so a critic re-run is seconds and byte-deterministic. The old pitch-7.4 hacks are therefore removed as obsolete: idle-0's manual phase [5,3] (a smear-avoidance offset that only mattered when features were thinner than a cell) and wall-tile's detail_dark_min_frac crack-rescue (the cracks now survive the fine pitch directly). Verified: zero key-adjacent pixels full-atlas, byte-identical double-run, warm skin on every face. Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain (GET /api/knowledge?file=projects/bureau/references/office/<sheet>&raw=1).
